phases.name: scope-intake-and-baseline

sipoc.input: round_id + round_goal + change_scope_ref + changed_assets + linkage_targets + superpower_ref
sipoc.process: baseline the scope and boundary for this governance round

phases.acceptance_criteria: scope baseline includes module boundary and linkage targets
phases.phase_purpose: 设定本轮治理的范围与边界基线
phases.input_context_ref: round_id + round_goal + change_scope_ref + changed_assets + linkage_targets + superpower_ref
phases.done_definition: 必须产出 scope_baseline_ref，并满足“范围基线包含模块边界与联动目标”
phases.handoff_note: 将 scope_baseline_ref 交接给 p2

phases.name: run-construction-audit

sipoc.process: audit linkage completeness and identify blocking gaps

phases.acceptance_criteria: linkage report contains missing items and blocking risks
phases.phase_purpose: 审计联动项完整性并识别阻塞缺口
phases.done_definition: 必须产出 linkage_report_ref，并满足“联动报告包含缺项与阻塞风险”
phases.handoff_note: 将 linkage_report_ref 交接给 p3

phases.name: execute-linked-updates

sipoc.process: apply linked updates across design docs, inventories and registries

phases.acceptance_criteria: all required linked artifacts are updated in the same round
phases.phase_purpose: 在设计文档、清单与注册表中同步落盘联动更新
phases.done_definition: 必须产出 m6_update_bundle_ref + construction_plane_delta_ref + open_questions_ref，并满足“所有必需联动资产在同一轮次完成更新”
phases.handoff_note: 将 m6_update_bundle_ref + construction_plane_delta_ref + open_questions_ref 交接给 p4

phases.name: sync-superpower-state

sipoc.input: round_id + round_goal + superpower_ref + anc_design_refs + decision_snapshot_ref + sync_actor + trigger_mode + risk_level + checkpoint_count + commit_count + round_evidence_log_ref + output_ref
sipoc.process: execute openspec sync and generate machine-readable sync record

phases.acceptance_criteria: openspec sync record is generated and schema-compliant
phases.phase_purpose: 执行 Superpower 同步并生成机器可读记录
phases.input_context_ref: round_id + round_goal + superpower_ref + anc_design_refs + decision_snapshot_ref + sync_actor + trigger_mode + risk_level + checkpoint_count + commit_count + round_evidence_log_ref + output_ref
phases.done_definition: 必须产出 superpower_sync_ref，并满足“Superpower 同步记录已生成且符合 schema”
phases.handoff_note: 将 superpower_sync_ref 交接给 p5

phases.name: verify-and-close

sipoc.process: run registry verification and close round with checkpoint and open-question reconciliation

phases.acceptance_criteria: registry verification passed and open questions are owned
phases.phase_purpose: 执行 registry 校验并完成 checkpoint 与开放问题对账后收口本轮
phases.done_definition: 必须产出 registry_verify_report_ref + round_close_summary_ref + construction_plane_delta_ref + open_questions_ref，并满足“registry 校验通过且开放问题已落实负责人”
phases.handoff_note: 将 registry_verify_report_ref + round_close_summary_ref + construction_plane_delta_ref + open_questions_ref 交接给 initiator
